This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

==Biology and appearance==
This large [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their mottled brown skin and multi-fold wattle that extended from their chin to their chest.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[3 BBY]], a member of this species served as [[Oathkeeper]] of the [[Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during its [[Imperial Era|reign]],<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> holding the position for at least a year.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Harvest|sixth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]] and aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]]<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> This species was designed by concept artist and sculptor [[Louis Wiltshire]], who revealed he is not allowed to share the concept art he created for this design until after the ''[[The Art of Star Wars: Andor]]'' releases<ref name="LW Concept">{{EmailCite|email=File:LouisWiltshireAliens-2025-07-19.png|creator=[[Louis Wiltshire]]|date=2025-07-19}}</ref> on [[May 19]], [[2026]].<ref name="AbramsBooks">{{Abrams|url=product/art-of-star-wars-andor-the-complete-series_9781419775680|text=The Art of Star Wars: Andor (The Complete Series)|archivedate=20250716092014}}</ref> He did state, however, that unlike the other aliens he created for the season, this design was based off specific prompts as opposed to just being a "generic" design.<ref name="LW Generic">{{EmailCite|email=File:LouisWiltshireAliens-2025-07-20.png|creator=[[Louis Wiltshire]]|date=2025-07-20}}</ref>
